**Before you install:** Model Quota is not notarized by Apple and is not signed with a Developer ID certificate. macOS blocks the first launch until you select **Open Anyway** in **System Settings → Privacy & Security**. Continue only if you trust this project and the source of your download.

- Requires macOS 14 or later on an Apple Silicon Mac.
- The ZIP includes `INSTALL.md` with step-by-step instructions.
- To verify the download, put the ZIP and its `.sha256` file in one folder and run `shasum -a 256 -c Model-Quota-*-macos-arm64.zip.sha256` there.
